params.message: CRITICAL HIT: Applicant name matched an active entry in global financial watchlists.
REGULATORY REJECTION: Applicant is under the legal age of 18. Account creation denied.
REGULATORY REJECTION: Applicant jurisdiction is subject to a FATF call for action (high-risk blacklist).
COMPLIANCE ALERT: Applicant identified as a Politically Exposed Person. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory before approval.
SCREENING UNAVAILABLE: The sanctions and PEP watchlist check could NOT be performed (provider unreachable). This profile has NOT been screened. Manual re-screening is required before any approval.

AGE VERIFICATION IMPOSSIBLE: No date of birth was provided in the application, and none could be read from the identity document. The mandatory minor check could NOT be performed for this applicant. A date of birth must be obtained and the file re-assessed before any approval.
FRAUD PATTERN: Both the name and the face fail to match the submitted document. This combination is characteristic of a stolen or borrowed identity document.
FRAUD PATTERN: Neither the name nor the ID number could be located on the document image. The document may not correspond to the application at all.

MULE ACCOUNT PATTERN: A young-adult profile combined with a disposable email address matches the documented recruitment pattern for money-mule accounts. Neither signal is conclusive alone; together they warrant enhanced due diligence.
BIOMETRIC CRITICAL ALERT: Server-side facial comparison concluded that the person in the selfie is not the document holder.
BIOMETRIC WARNING: The facial comparison could not be settled automatically. Manual visual comparison required.
BIOMETRIC NOTICE: Likely the same person, but below the high-confidence threshold. Match accepted with reservation.
BIOMETRIC MISSING: No usable face could be extracted from the document or the selfie. Identity was NOT biometrically verified. Manual visual comparison is mandatory.
OCR ALERT: Applicant name could not be verified on the provided Identity Document image.
OCR ALERT: ID Number (CIN) does not match the text extracted from the document.
OCR UNAVAILABLE: The document image could not be read (unreadable, timed out, or processing failed). Document data was NOT cross-verified. Manual review required.
JURISDICTION RISK: Applicant country is under increased FATF monitoring (grey list). Enhanced due diligence recommended.
Risk Warning: Disposable email domain detected.
Structure Failure: The identification number does not match the expected format for the declared country.
Missing telephony structure for multi-factor lookup.
DOCUMENT EXPIRED: The identification document is past its expiry date and cannot be accepted as valid proof of identity.
DATA MISMATCH: The date of birth on the document does not match the one declared in the application.

PROFILE NOTE (informational, no score impact): Applicant is under 25. Recorded for audit purposes only. Age alone is not treated as a risk factor; it is scored only in combination with other indicators.
High-trust biometric document layout analyzed (Passport).
